title: Sources
subtitle: How data enters and leaves a resource
description: fetch, query bridge, store bridge, and controlled value modes.
content: Pick one primary way to supply source data. Save always goes through `source.save` (or a mutation bridge).

sections.title: Native fetch + save
sections.content: Simplest for forms that own their network calls:

sections.title: Bridge an existing query
sections.content: Adapt qortex-query (or similar) via `source.query`. Resource reads `data` / status and can call `refetch`. Note: `query.staleTime` marks stale but does not auto-refetch in alpha.

sections.title: Bridge a store
sections.content: `source.state` with get / set / subscribe keeps the resource in sync with qortex-store (or any similar store).

sections.title: Controlled value
sections.content: `source.value` + `onChange` for fully parent-controlled entities (rare for large forms).

sections.title: initialData
sections.content: Sync object or Promise. Useful for create-new flows without a fetch.
